meta.title: 雅思阅读高频短语
meta.source: 雅思阅读百大高频短语结构化抽取

phrases.meaning: 吸引…的注意力(被动语态):be absorbed in 全神贯注于…近:be engrossed in ; be lost in ; be rapt in ;be concentrated on ; be focused on ; be centered on

phrases.phrase: (be) abundant in(be rich in; be well supplied with)

phrases.meaning: 不可数名词) 能接近,进入,了解
偶然地,意外. Without accident(=safely) 安全地,

phrases.phrase: of one’s own accord(=without being asked; willingly; freely)

phrases.meaning: 与…一致 . out of one’s accord with 同….不一致
为了某人的缘故, 为了某人自己的利益 2)(=at one’s own risk) 自行负责 3)(=by oneself)依靠自己 on account 赊账; on account of 因为; on no account 不论什么原因也不;of …account 有…..重要性.

phrases.phrase: account for (=give an explanation or reason for)
on no account(=in no case, for no reason)
phrases.meaning: 绝不要,无论如何不要(放句首时句子要倒装)

phrases.phrase: accuse…of…(=charge…with; blame sb. for sth. ; blame sth. on sb. ; complain about)
be accustomed to (=be in the habit of, be used to)
be acquainted with(=to have knowledge of)
phrases.meaning: 了解; (=to have met socially) 熟悉
奉行,按照…行动; act as 扮演; act for 代理

phrases.phrase: adapt…(for) (=make sth. Suitable for a new need)
phrases.meaning: 改编, 改写(以适应新的需要)

phrases.phrase: in addition to(=as well as, besides, other than)
adhere to (=abide by, conform to, comply with, cling to, insist on, persist in, observe, opinion, belief )
phrases.meaning: 粘附; 坚持, 遵循

phrases.phrase: admit of (=be capable of, leave room for) …
phrases.meaning: 的可能， 留有…的余地.
有利的,使优点更加突出地.
胜过. have the advantage of 由于…处于有利条件 have the advantage of sb.知道某人所不知道的事

phrases.phrase: take advantage of (=make the best of, utilize, make use of, profit from, harness)

phrases.meaning: 赞同(某人意见) agree to 同意
在…之前, 超过…;……………. ahead of time 提前.
不肯定, 不具体. 2)在谣传中.

phrases.phrase: above all (=especially, most important of all)
in all (=counting everyone or everything, altogether)

phrases.meaning: 毕竟,到底; (not) at all 一点也不; all at once(=suddenly)突然; once and for all 只此一次; above all 最重要的; first of all 首先; all in all 大体上说; be all in 累极了; all but 几乎.

phrases.phrase: allow for (=take into consideration, take into account)
answer for (undertake responsibility for, be liable for, take charge for)

phrases.meaning: 为…焦急不安; 或 anxious for
为某事向某人呼吁. appeal to sb. 对某人有吸引力
为…向…申请 ; apply for 申请; apply to 适用.

phrases.phrase: approve of (=consent to, be in favor of, favor, agree to, consider good, right)
phrases.meaning: 赞成, approve vt. 批准

phrases.phrase: arrange for sb./sth. to do sth.

phrases.meaning: 到达; arrive at 到达某地(小地方);得出,作出; arrive in 到达某地(大地方);

phrases.phrase: be ashamed of (=feel shame, guilt or sorrow because of sth. done)
assure sb. of sth. (=try to cause to believe or trust in sth.)
make an attempt at doing sth. (to do sth.)
attend to (=give one’s attention, care and thought)
phrases.meaning: 注意,照顾;attend on(upon)(=wait upon, serve, look after) 侍候,照料

phrases.phrase: attribute…to…(=to believe sth. to be the result of…)
phrases.meaning: 把..归因于.., 认为..是..的结果

phrases.phrase: on the average (=on average, on an average)
(be) aware of (=be conscious of , having knowledge or consciousness)

phrases.meaning: 在…后部(里面); on the back of 在…后部(外面); be on one’s back(=be ill in bed) 卧病不起.

phrases.phrase: at one’s back(=supporting or favoring sb.)
phrases.meaning: 支持,维护; have sb. at one’s back 有…支持, 有…作后台

phrases.phrase: turn one’s back on sb. (=turn away from sb. in an impolite way)

phrases.meaning: 以…开始. to begin with (=first of all) 首先, 第一(经常用于开始语)

phrases.phrase: on behalf of (=as the representative of)
believe in(=have faith or trust in; consider sth./sb. to be true)

phrases.meaning: 在出生上,论出身,按血统 at birth 在出生时; give birth to 出生
因…责备某人 . blame sth. on sb. 把…推在某人身上
开花(指树木) be in blossom 开花(强调状态) come into blossom 开花(强调动作)
到船上, 在船上, 上火车或飞机

phrases.phrase: in brief(=in as few words as possible)

phrases.meaning: 于某事。 be busy doing sth. 忙于做某事
能够, 有能力 be capable of being +过去分词:是能够被…的

phrases.phrase: in any case(=for love or money, at any rate, at any price, at any cost, whatever happens; anyhow)
in case of (=in the event of)
phrases.meaning: 如果发生…万一 in the case of 至于…, 就…而言
在任何情况下都不(放句首倒装句)

phrases.phrase: center one’s attention on(=focus one’s attention on)
phrases.meaning: 把某人的注意力集中在…上
